revisionHistory.finding: The shared control sizing made the log-row checkbox oversized and crowded the 320 px layout.
revisionHistory.resolution: Scoped large touch targets to buttons, search and selects; restored an 18 px checkbox with a full clickable label; added a deliberate mobile control grid.

remainingBoundary: Desktop Chromium emulation does not qualify Android WebView, keyboard, insets, background lifetime or real-device gestures.
